statement: Reposition or reshape the current selection in lattice editing with "Flip (Distortion Free)"; the resulting positions or shapes match Blender 5.3 for the same input, only the selected items change, and one undo step restores them.

Run the data operation "Make Regular" on the current selection in lattice editing; the resulting data matches Blender 5.3 for the same input, the operation reports a clear error when the input is invalid, and one undo step restores the original.
Change what is selected in lattice editing with "(De)select All"; the new selection is what the next edit command acts on, no data is modified, and one undo step restores the previous selection.
Change what is selected in lattice editing with "Select Less"; the new selection is what the next edit command acts on, no data is modified, and one undo step restores the previous selection.
Change what is selected in lattice editing with "Select Mirror"; the new selection is what the next edit command acts on, no data is modified, and one undo step restores the previous selection.
